svg.title: How pg_pinecone works
svg.desc: An application sends pgvector SQL to Postgres, which keeps the rows and their vector column. pg_pinecone runs the search with one of three engines. The native engine, the default, uses IVF and RaBitQ, with a smaller index than HNSW and faster search at equal recall. The pgvector engine uses HNSW or IVFFlat. The remote engine runs on Pinecone: writes sync to a Pinecone serverless index, and results come back to Postgres.
